description: Den Texstraat 21-27 (1872-77 by BAG): the Den Texstraat 7-15 design (ground + two upper storeys, white sill bands and bracket hoods, heavy entablature, slate mansard) with iron balconettes on the middle axis of both upper storeys and a wide three-light pediment dormer with flanking cheeks over the middle and neighbouring axes; the balcony on the top storey only (Den Texstraat 23)

match.note: Den Texstraat 21-27 on the 2024-12-04 strip: dormers 3.2 m wide (three lights) 12.2-14.8 m; iron balconettes on the centre axis, storeys 1 and 2

mansard-wide-dormer.note: a white pediment dormer about 3.2 m wide with three lights and cheek pieces, 12.2-14.8 m

door-left.note: house door on the left axis; a pand whose door reads on the right is mirrored

roof.evidence: Den Texstraat 1-59: the black slate mansard 12.0-13.1 m behind the entablature, a steep front slope under the dormers

rhythm.roofline: heavy white entablature, slate mansard, one pediment dormer

evidence.citation: tex-1-59 strip 2024-12-04 spans 2923-3904 px: dormers 3.2 m wide, iron balconettes on the centre axis at storeys 1 and 2, otherwise the 7-15 storey lines

notes: Opus verdict: flat heads with keystones on both upper storeys, white pier blocks and dentils; the raised-centre three-part dormer is not in the kit
